sourceOfTruth: packages/knowledge-hub/src/tools/skills-conformance-check.ts — compareTwin (lines 925-950), the single read/compare of one dataset/installed script pair. Its ONE try block wraps both readFileSync calls, so every read failure is labelled with datasetRel regardless of which side threw.

domains.discriminator: which side of the pair the read of the comparison fails on (neither | dataset | installed | both), plus the pre-read existence branch
domains.note: The errno alone cannot identify the side: EISDIR ('illegal operation on a directory, read') carries NO path, and EACCES carries an absolute tmp path, not the skill-relative one. The emitted row's leading path is therefore the only signal a maintainer gets about which copy to open. `pair-workflow-phase/scripts/go.mjs` CONTAINS `workflow/phase/scripts/go.mjs` as a substring, so only an anchored/token-bounded assertion can tell the two sides apart — the reason the pre-existing toContain guard admitted the misattributing message.
